evidence.quote: A brand is not a logo. A brand is compressed trust.
Their distinctive unit is the shared name governed as a commons.
The right to fork is decisive.
People cooperate when the commons makes them more capable.
The promise must be narrow enough to audit and broad enough to let branches adapt.
repairable furniture designed globally and made locally

visualIdentity: An inhabited repairable-furniture commons: cobalt work surfaces, warm ash wood, terracotta garments, brass joints, cream instructions. Recurring replaceable joint and credited repair page tie distinct scales together. No interchangeable floating hammers, token economy, stock success charts or repeated person-with-three-props layout.

scenes.art: Start close on a maker aligning a replaceable chair part at a maintained workbench. A public winner profile appears off to one side while unfinished quality instructions and customer enquiries occupy the maker. The volume is introduced as questioning the selection game, not condemning competent work. No quantified failure distribution or invented personal biography.

scenes.existingTitle: A winner is not the average
scenes.art: Pull back to multiple independent workstations at varied stages; a single public success poster frames only one. A quiet camera mask alternately crops to the poster and opens to reveal testing, repair and abandoned prototypes. None represents a population sample or numerical likelihood. Distinct posed people do actual work; no literal lottery gambling props.

Show a design assistant producing chair-plan variants at two independent shops, followed by more manufactured possibilities. A customer still asks about repair and dependable service. A trained maker redirects attention from variant count to a missing service history; no AI speed multiplier or guaranteed economic effect.

scenes.directionTitle: Give shared work an owner and a record
scenes.art: One maker writes a repair instruction; another uses that instruction on a matching joint. Keep author credit attached to the reusable page. A discussion pauses over who maintains the instruction and how effort is recognized. This is a conceptual instance of the source’s contribution accounting, not an observed business or promised remuneration.

Change scale to an inhabited training bench. An experienced maker demonstrates the replaceable joint while a newer operator practices it; the shared instructional record remains available to another shop. Responsibility moves through teaching and standards, not through putting the founder’s face on every artifact. The camera follows the tool and learner’s action.

scenes.existingTitle: A shared name must mean something
scenes.directionTitle: A shared promise customers can check
scenes.art: Two independent furniture workshops use the same legible narrow promise, Repairable furniture. A customer compares an operator entry, the shared repair standard and the chair’s actual replaceable joint. A named-maintenance record is carried from earlier scene. Show authorized status as a proposed registry arrangement, not certified product claims. A fork/exit branch retains traceable history with a visibly distinct name, never duplicates indistinguishable brands.

scenes.directionTitle: Start small and test the burden
scenes.art: Return to one workshop’s actual repeated repair procedure and a small training cohort. Compare duplicated manuals with a single maintained version, but retain the meeting time and unresolved contribution question needed to govern it. No income, survival rate or universal efficiency guarantee. Source doctrine demands comparison with isolated work, not automatic endorsement.

scenes.existingTitle: Read the rules before the pitch
scenes.directionTitle: Read the game you are building
scenes.art: Close on a reader handling the book beside the chair joint and credited instruction used throughout. A chapter tab points from entrepreneurial selection to shared-brand governance. The maker turns from the success poster toward the unresolved common-work question. End on a specific reading invitation already present in the preserved narration; no claim the fictional shops proved the proposal.

boundaries: Source explicitly offers repairable furniture as an illustrative narrow shared promise; the film’s workshops and people remain conceptual examples.
Never imply successful trial, a real brand, verified operator certification or financial return.
Repeated motif must change through useful action: joint repaired, instruction credited, skill taught, authorization checked, history retained on exit.
Preserve separate themes and readable large headings; inspect every scene rather than treating color changes as artistic variety.
